question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) and complete the following letter-cluster series?

HSU, JQO, LOI, NME, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa718dc3d80fa09b3eda3b7ebcb501ae0d35fbb68f85c6fcb0b5de22c71bf85f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34ce7fe6fcb88e3b891e5df04233885e25928a13710bb85b337d246a99e1aa26.png] 

**Reverse Vowel series:** U, O, I, E, A

Hence, '**PKA**' is the correct answer.
